queer_characters.name: Richard/Bianca Del Rio
queer_characters.notes: Explicitly described as a gay schoolteacher who is outed and fired; uses his drag persona to confront and expose the homophobic discrimination that cost him his job.

contributor_notes: Richard is a gay man; Bianca Del Rio is his drag persona (drag is a performance art, not a gender identity, so no separate identity tag was applied). Source text does not confirm creators' identities, subtitle or audio languages. Central theme is LGBTQ+ employment discrimination (legal in Texas at the time) played for comedy with stated intent to raise awareness. Maintainer should verify language availability and any creator self-identification.
